## What's new in AniTenshi 1.0.17

- **Google Drive sign-in built into Android**: connecting Google Drive now uses your phone's own Google account picker instead of the browser. It takes a couple of taps, and Settings show which account is connected. The app no longer carries a Google key or keeps a long-lived token. It needs Google Play services on the device.
- **Already connected?** The app keeps syncing. If Google needs you to confirm, you get a notification asking you to connect again from Settings › Data and storage.
- **English and Italian everywhere**: the sync messages ("Sync complete" and the errors) are now in your language. Any text that isn't translated into your language yet shows in English.
- **Clearer Google Drive messages**: if access to Google Drive is removed, the app tells you to connect again instead of showing a technical error.
- **Release notes in English**: from this version on, the update notes are written in English.
